subject.title: feat(android): add Wear conversations, voice, agents, and sessions

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the full Wear conversation companion and its phone-proxy protocol now, or prove and release the narrower status bridge first?
rationale: The branch creates an official application, persistent user defaults, a versioned cross-device protocol, new dependencies, CI lanes, and a Play distribution contract; code review cannot choose that permanent product and support commitment.

options.title: Stage status first
options.body: Review and land the narrow status bridge at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/108803, then rebase a smaller conversation follow-up after distribution and security contracts are proven.

options.title: Sponsor the full surface
options.body: Accept the complete companion direction after the concrete release, privacy, timeout, and naming blockers are fixed and Android ownership signs off.

options.title: Pause official Wear support
options.body: Close or defer both branches if the project is not ready to own a second Android application and cross-device protocol.

recommendation.title: Stage status first
recommendation.body: Review and land the narrow status bridge at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/108803, then rebase a smaller conversation follow-up after distribution and security contracts are proven.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is the strongest available Android product-area routing signal, with repository-wide review and CI owners supporting the release decision.
